item.title: CVE-2024-51324 · BYOVD: Three Undocumented Kernel Primitives in BdApiUtil64.sys
item.description: TL;DR: BdApiUtil64.sys creates \Device\BdApiUtil with SecurityDescriptor = NULL — accessible from any process at any integrity level. The termination handler uses PsLookupProcessByProcessId + ObOpenObjectByPointer(KernelMode), bypassing SeAccessCheck unconditionally. ZwOpenProcess is completely absent from the import table. Ghidra analysis reveals two additional primitives with no prior public documentation: arbitrary file deletion (0x80002648) and in-use file deletion with SectionObjectPointer bypass (0x8000264C). No authentication. Deterministic for non-PPL targets. NVD: Awaiting Analysis · ADP CISA: CVSS 3.8 (Low) · CWE-269.
